blockers.statement: The applied-migration ledger of the staging project (supabase_migrations.schema_migrations) could not be read (no permission). Which main-only names the platform considers applied on staging is unknown; object presence is inferred from the schema, not from the ledger. The forward-only reconciliation migration is safe regardless of the ledger, but replaying main's older migrations on staging (e.g. 20260919175712 creating tables that exist) still depends on the platform marking those names applied.
blockers.resolution_path: Export supabase_migrations.schema_migrations from staging (read-only) and attach it; then decide, with the Cloud owner, whether to mark 20260915161655 (staging content), 20260919175712, the three renamed pairs and 20261002050000/050331 as applied on staging without executing them.
blockers.closure: Ledger obtained (ART-0012): 35 rows, 31 with byte-verified SQL. 20260915161655 and 20261002052550 present; 20260919175712/175907/195620/195651 and 20261002045629/050000/050331 absent; question_commercial_release, production_release_pool, founder_access_denials absent — exactly the gap PR #9's forward-only migration fills. Residual platform-semantics risk tracked as BLK-PLATFORM-APPLY-SEMANTICS.
